texts.orig: The  phrase 'fetishization of originality' implies that society has developed an obsession or over-glorification of originality, treating it as something sacred or superior. The author criticizes this attitude because it causes creators to ignore the importance of imitation and learning from past knowledge. Hence, option (a) is the most appropriate answer.
